<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>MACRO PRO — CNC workshop tools</title>
<meta name="description" content="MACRO PRO: CNC workshop tools for turning and milling — contour, threads, text engraving, macro programs, speeds and feeds, and a program simulator.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
  :root{--bg:#eef6f7;--card:#fff;--ink:#0c1f24;--muted:#58717a;--line:#dde9eb;
        --teal:#06b6c4;--teal-d:#0894a0}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);
       color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6}
  .wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 20px 56px}
  header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:28px}
  header img{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(8,148,160,.25)}
  h1{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1.1}
  .tag{color:var(--teal-d);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-top:4px}
  .lead{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:28px}
  h2{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-d);
     margin:34px 0 12px}
  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:12px}
  .tool{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px}
  .tool b{display:block;font-size:15.5px}
  .tool span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px}
  .links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .links a{display:block;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
           padding:14px 18px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
  .links a small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
  .links a:hover{border-color:var(--teal)}
  a{color:var(--teal-d)}
  footer{margin-top:40px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="MACRO PRO app icon">
    <div>
      <h1>MACRO PRO</h1>
      <div class="tag">CNC workshop tools for turning and milling</div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <p class="lead">Build CNC programs on your phone. Draw a turned profile, set text round the face
  of a bar, work out a thread, and check the program in the simulator before it goes to the machine.
  Every tool runs on the device.</p>

  <h2>Tools</h2>
  <div class="grid">
    <div class="tool"><b>ShopTurn Contour</b><span>Turned profiles with nose-radius compensation</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Text Engraver</b><span>Flat, rotary and turn-mill face engraving</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Turning Threads</b><span>Metric, UN, BSP, NPT, Acme — G76, G92, G32</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Macro Generator</b><span>Pockets, bores, polygons in Macro B</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Program Simulator</b><span>Test any program before you cut it</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Study Programming</b><span>G-code, M-code and Macro B lessons</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Speeds &amp; Feeds</b><span>RPM, feed and cutting speed</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>PCD Calculator</b><span>Bolt-circle holes and the drilling program</span></div>
    <div class="tool"><b>Right Triangle</b><span>Two knowns in, every side and angle out</span></div>
  </div>

  <h2>Privacy and your account</h2>
  <div class="links">
    <a href="privacy.html">Privacy policy<small>What MACRO PRO collects and why</small></a>
    <a href="delete-account.html">Delete your account<small>How to have your account and data removed</small></a>
  </div>

  <h2>Contact</h2>
  <div class="card">
    Questions, problems or feature requests:
    <a href="mailto:macropro200@gmail.com">macropro200@gmail.com</a>
  </div>

  <footer>&copy; 2026 Jagpreet Gautam. MACRO PRO. All rights reserved.</footer>
</div>
</body>
</html>
